title: Treatise of Paired Endings
summary: A treatise on stopping two functions of a foe at once and on letting two roots of one sickness lapse together in a friend.

title: The Azure Pall Canon
summary: A canon of the pale pall that settles on the sky-sworn field and takes the strength from all beneath it.

title: The Dual-Track Cessation Doctrine
summary: A doctrine of two tracks of ending qi run side by side one to wither a foe and one to ease a friend.

title: The Basin Wane Mastery
summary: A mastery of gathering ending qi in the body like water in a basin and letting it out slowly or all at once.

title: Sapphire Ash Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of cold blue-grey ash that falls from the qi field to still the living and to calm the sick.

title: The Plateau Wither Canon
summary: A canon of broad slow withering that settles on a whole stretch of open ground and all who stand on it.

title: Treatise of the Oath-Bound Ending
summary: A treatise on an ending sworn to be quick and clean and on a release sworn to a friend in the same breath.

title: The Windward Wane Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of waning qi carried before the wind to reach foes upwind and sickness lifted off those behind.

title: Manual of the Bearing Dirge
summary: A manual of sung dirges that take a bearing on a foe's life and also settle the nerves of a friend.

title: Canon of the Sworn Entropy
summary: A canon of entropy sworn to run only where the user points it and to leave allies untouched.
